content.en: Economic growth is primarily measured through **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** and **Gross National Product (GNP)**. These metrics quantify the total economic output within a specific timeframe. In the context of the **Indian Economy**, growth is assessed by comparing real output against base year prices to eliminate the impact of inflation.
